name: Connector retaining wire identity
aliases: Connector retaining wire identity IEC reference
summary: This form identifies a separable connector whose publisher representation preserves wire-number identity across the interface.
description: This form identifies a separable connector whose publisher representation preserves wire-number identity across the interface. The electrical connection passes through mating connector pins while the drafting system retains the wire identifier. Connector tags and pin numbers still describe the separable interface.
Use the pin mapping to link both sides and retain connector identity even where wire labels match. A wiring report should not erase the physical connector simply because the number is continuous.
readingNotes: Document connector and pin tags independently of the continuous wire identifier.
Wire-number continuity is a drafting-data convention and does not eliminate the connector's separable physical interface.
